down_to_earth.title: Optimal Initial Positioning
down_to_earth.principle: Place the red ball near the green ball but not overlapping to ensure a precise collision.
down_to_earth.when_to_apply: When placing the red ball for the first time.

down_to_earth.title: Red Ball Positioning for Strong Impulse
down_to_earth.principle: Place the red ball closer to the green ball and near the edge of the platform to ensure a strong and directed collision impulse.
down_to_earth.when_to_apply: When the red ball needs to provide a strong impulse to the green ball.

down_to_earth.title: Dynamic Ball Interaction
down_to_earth.principle: Ensure the collision impulse between the red and green balls is strong enough to push the green ball.
down_to_earth.when_to_apply: When the red ball needs to interact with the green ball to achieve a specific outcome.

down_to_earth.title: Platform Edge Geometry Consideration
down_to_earth.principle: Ensure the red ball is placed near the edge of the platform to maximize the collision impulse towards the edge.
down_to_earth.when_to_apply: When the red ball needs to push the green ball off the platform edge.

down_to_earth.title: Valid Placement Region
down_to_earth.principle: Ensure the red ball is placed within a valid region to avoid overlap with the green ball and platform.
down_to_earth.when_to_apply: When placing the red ball to avoid overlap.

down_to_earth.description: Agent repeatedly tries to place the red ball in the same crowded area around the green ball.
down_to_earth.why_it_happens: The agent may not explore different placements due to a lack of confidence in other areas.
down_to_earth.how_to_avoid: Implement a strategy to explore different regions around the green ball before settling on a placement.

down_to_earth.description: Agent fails to properly simulate the action after finding a valid placement.
down_to_earth.why_it_happens: The agent may not fully understand the consequences of the placement and the need for simulation.
down_to_earth.how_to_avoid: Ensure the agent simulates the action after each valid placement to check the outcome.

down_to_earth.description: Agent does not consider the direction and magnitude of the collision impulse.
down_to_earth.why_it_happens: The agent may not fully understand the importance of the direction and magnitude of the impulse.
down_to_earth.how_to_avoid: Incorporate a strategy to analyze and adjust the impulse direction and magnitude based on the placement.
